name: Style jjp palette content
description: Spruce up the jjp command palette content itself, not just the fzf chrome. Requirements: enable ANSI rendering in fzf, make action rows visually richer while preserving hidden search fields and action id selection, color/highlight preview sections and commands, keep output restrained and terminal-friendly, and verify with Rust tests plus existing smoke checks.
result: Styled jjp palette content: candidate rows now use ANSI hierarchy with bold titles, cyan shortcut summaries, dim tags, while hidden tab fields still carry searchable tags/shortcuts/expanded commands/descriptions. Preview output now has styled title, WHY/STEPS/INSERTS sections, bold shortcut commands, and dim expanded commands. Enabled fzf --ansi. Verification: cargo fmt --check, cargo test (13 passed), tests/jjp-bin.zsh, tests/jjhelp-flows-expanded.zsh, zsh -n, git diff --check, LF checks, and --list/--preview smoke samples passed.

name: Implement jjp command palette
description: Execute docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-15-jjp-command-palette.md inline. Build the Rust jjp-bin action registry, rendering, fzf integration, parameter resolvers, zsh wrapper, installer/docs, and tests. Keep the first version insert-only and hardcoded actions per the spec.
result: Implemented the jjp fzf command palette as a Rust binary, wired the zsh wrapper and installer, documented usage, added focused tests, ignored Cargo build output, and verified cargo/zsh/smoke/LF checks.

name: Merge direct-land flow guidance
description: Update jjhelp flows to treat direct landing as the normal workflow and remove PR creation from the default flows. Fold the shortcut flow work and expanded -F output into a direct-workflow story: happy path should include sync/evolve/tug/push, catch up should be standalone, undo mistake should show op log + undo, and no default open-a-PR/gh pr create flow should render. Acceptance criteria: tests cover default -f and expanded -F output, README sample matches, zsh syntax/diff whitespace/LF checks pass.
result: Updated default jjhelp flows to teach direct-to-main instead of PR creation: happy path now includes sync/evolve/tug main/push main, added catch up and undo mistake flows, removed open-a-PR/gh pr create from default flows, and updated README/test expectations. Verification: tests/jjhelp-flows-expanded.zsh passed and manual jjhelp -f render showed the direct-to-main flows.

name: Design fzf jj command palette
description: Capture the approved architecture for an intent-first jj command palette: Rust binary for action registry and parameter resolution, fzf as the fast searchable terminal UI, zsh wrapper for print -z prompt insertion, and parameter pickers for bookmarks/revisions/files/remotes/free text. Acceptance criteria: design spec describes goals, architecture, interaction model, parameter handling, action schema, implementation phases, testing, and open decisions.
result: Wrote docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-15-jjp-command-palette-design.md. The spec defines jjp as an intent-first fzf command palette backed by a Rust jjp-bin and a zsh print -z wrapper, with typed parameter resolvers for bookmarks, revisions, files, remotes, and free text. It fixes first-version decisions: insert-only, hardcoded Rust actions, separate initial alias expansion implementation, and no PR-oriented first-screen actions. Verification: placeholder scan for TBD/TODO/Open Decisions/maybe returned no matches; LF check passed.

name: Plan jjp command palette implementation
description: Write a detailed implementation plan for the approved jjp command palette design. The plan should cover Rust binary scaffolding, action registry, command rendering, fzf integration, parameter resolvers, zsh wrapper/install/docs, tests, and verification. It should reference docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-15-jjp-command-palette-design.md and be saved under docs/superpowers/plans/.
result: Wrote docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-15-jjp-command-palette.md. The plan implements the approved jjp spec through seven task groups: Rust scaffold/action registry, rendering and quoting, non-interactive CLI, fzf action selection, parameter resolvers, zsh/install/docs wiring, and final verification. Self-review coverage maps every spec requirement to tasks; placeholder scan returned no matches after cleanup; LF check passed.

name: Polish jjp fzf palette
description: Improve the jjp fzf command palette presentation so it feels intentional rather than raw. Requirements: replace the bold action> prompt, use cleaner fzf chrome/pointer/layout/color options, keep candidate rows useful for matching against title/tags/shortcut/expanded command while displaying the title cleanly, and verify with focused Rust tests plus existing smoke checks.
result: Polished the jjp fzf palette: replaced action> with jj ›, display rows now show only action titles while hidden metadata remains searchable, added double-line labeled/padded retro window chrome, preview labels/window styling, tmux/Zellij popup support, and updated tests. Verification: cargo fmt --check, cargo test (11 passed), tests/jjp-bin.zsh, tests/jjhelp-flows-expanded.zsh, zsh -n, git diff --check, and LF checks passed.

name: Add expanded flow output option
description: Add an optional expanded-flow view to jjhelp. Default flow output should stay shortcut-first. New -F/--flows-expanded mode should render flows only and show shortcut forms plus exploded definitions for known shell aliases and jj config aliases, including compound rows like jj sync && jj evolve. Update README usage. Acceptance criteria: red/green shell test covers expanded output; default -f remains shortcut-only; zsh syntax, diff whitespace, and LF checks pass.
result: Added jjhelp -F/--flows-expanded. Default -f remains shortcut-only; -F renders flows-only and expands known shell aliases plus jj config aliases inline, including compound jj sync && jj evolve rows. Added tests/jjhelp-flows-expanded.zsh with a stub jj command to exercise alias/config expansion without relying on ambient config. Updated README usage and jjhelp --help text. Verification: tests/jjhelp-flows-expanded.zsh passed, zsh -n jjhelp.zsh tests/jjhelp-flows-expanded.zsh passed, git diff --check passed, and perl CRLF check over README.md, jjhelp.zsh, and the new test passed.

name: Show jj shortcut forms in flows docs
description: Update the flows section documentation so common jj workflows show the ZSH shortcut aliases instead of only full jj commands. Source shortcuts from oh-my-zsh's jj plugin plus Daniel's ad hoc .zshrc aliases where available. Acceptance criteria: flows list uses shortcut-oriented examples, preserves useful full-command context where needed, and verification confirms docs/scripts still parse or relevant checks pass.
result: Updated jjhelp flows to show shortcut-first forms: happy path now uses jjnt and jjdmsg, and land-on-main uses jjgp --bookmark main instead of the full jj git push command. README sample output was updated to match. Verification: focused zsh render assertion passed, zsh -n jjhelp.zsh passed, git diff --check passed, and perl CRLF check over README.md and jjhelp.zsh passed.
